speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand your baby is an infant with bilious vomiting and an inability to pass meconium, accompanied by abdominal distension. To better understand the situation, could you please tell me exactly how old the baby is and how many days have passed since the first bowel movement?

REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Dilated loops of bowel with no gas in the rectum, suggestive of a distal obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung's disease. The combination of delayed meconium passage, bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, and an abdominal X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with no gas in the rectum is highly characteristic of this condition.
